*Note:* tier=full; Zenodo record 14525182; hippocampal cultures on MEA2100-256, 10 min spontaneous recordings, DIV 12-21; straight (Control) against asymmetric microchannels (Arrows, Rams, Tesla); 2_Raw_Images.zip (66 MB widefield images) not fetched. Licence conflict resolved by the deposit's corresponding author by email on 2026-09-21, copying the first author: they confirmed that the Zenodo metadata licence (CC BY 4.0) is the one they intend, and that the README's CC BY-NC-ND line was an unintentional default they can no longer edit. The metadata licence field is the operative licence and is publicly checkable; the README's contradicting text is recorded below rather than ignored. The correspondence itself is private and a reader cannot verify it - see data/SOURCES.md. README as fetched still states: 'THIS DATASET IS PUBLICALLY AVAILABLE UNDER A CREATIVE COMMONS CC BY-NC-ND LICENSE (ATTRIBUTION-NONCOMMERCIAL-NODERIVS)'
